subject: english-literature
title: Lines and Stanzas
welcome_lead: Before sense, a poem is shapes on a page. Learn the parts.
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on lines, stanzas and basic poetry layout.
final_note: You can now name a poem's basic visual building blocks.

concepts.def: One row of words in a poem.

walkthroughs.body_html: A line is one row of poetry; a stanza is a group of lines separated by a blank line — like a paragraph in prose.
A couplet = 2 lines, often rhyming. A quatrain = 4 lines, very common in pop songs and ballads.
Enjambment is when sense flows over a line break without a pause. It creates speed or surprise.
